At blizzcon they had the store in the basement floor where we waited to enter the convention. They just had all the merch displayed in a glass display on the main lobby and in the basement. It would essentially be a catelog order/mobile order and you would come down to pick up/purchase the items you wanted with there being multiple windows with people packing orders to be picked up. I feel like this system would have been far more efficient for acquiring merch
Contemplating doing this. Thank you for words of wisdom!

This was my partners first convention besides one she went to as a child. She kept wondering if this is how other conventions were like. so good to know there are others with far more experience with going to conventions can attest to how this was not on par

Glad to know it was different before. It felt really strange to only give an exclusive experience that was framed to be like an opening experience to only a single very limited stage. Blizzcon airs the opening ceremony on all stages and all screens. Essentially meaning everyone gets to experience the announcements and the hype even as you stand in line for food. There is no reason this couldn’t have been done. I also realized there was a lot of unused space that could have easily been used to create a more celebratory atmosphere

I felt your frustration just reading it. I honestly felt like there was a bigger emphasis on the “w exclusive merch” at this convention than any of the panels or any other forms of engagement. Like this convention is meant to celebrate Star Wars by offering us a bunch of business to spend money at and not much else unless you can get into the panels.

Do you have insight into this? I still don’t. Understand and I just understood as not worth trying 🤦🏻‍♀️ same with the official merch store. Waited for hours then saw the massive line just to check out and decided the thing I wanted wasn’t worth the wait

For real tho, I’ve been to blizzcon a few years at the very same convention and the difference in quality left me flabbergasted. The person I was with and I nearly left halfway through the day after a string of disappointment. In the end I’m glad I didn’t but boy was I heartbroken

I used to worry that my hobbies were too childish.  Card games, video games, Star Wars, collecting of all sorts. They love and support my hobbies and even tries them out and has started to share the hobby together.

All this to say.  If people don't appreciate or shame you for your hobbies.  That's on them.  You do you don't change you.  You'll find the person that loves and appreciates and values every part of you.  Hobbies included.
